comment: Authoritative pin record for the autonomous JIT-porting foundry. The four repositories are pinned to exact commits; the FRF/Gemel/MSRV versions are the tested ones. Reproduce the baseline with scripts/integration_baseline.sh.

phorensicos.note: The baseline commit this foundry work starts from. The baseline receipt records the commit it was generated at, which may be later.

frf_fuzz.note: Reconciled to frf 0.1.86 / gemel 0.11.1 (see frf-fuzz docs/DEPENDENCY_RECONCILIATION.md). The recorded commit is the reconciliation commit; if it is amended, this pin must be updated to the amended commit.
